verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a project-tracking product could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from its data. The evidence only shows user-built charts and 'insights' (not AI-generated), manual status updates, and assigning issues to Copilot to delegate work, which is task execution rather than insights or suggestions from project data. The official MCP server and API are developer building blocks for external agents, not in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
